title: NDIS autism participants per 1,000 population, by state, Dec 2024
description: NDIS Data Research: active autism participants per 1,000 total population, by state/territory (all ages; population denominator is ABS Estimated Resident Population, 31 Dec 2024, exact date match). Genuinely autism-specific (not a general developmental-vulnerability proxy like the AEDC-based maps), but note this measures NDIS ACCESS/participation, which can reflect service availability as much as underlying prevalence.
